recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast graphic composition featuring two male figures in a dynamic, forward-leaning pose at the bottom, set against a stark white background. The upper two-thirds are dominated by massive, overlapping sans-serif typography arranged on a diagonal axis in black, red, and grey, complemented by a striped hazard-style border element on the left.
coreVisualRelationships: The diagonal tilt of the red text creates a sense of kinetic energy and movement.
The overlapping layers of text create depth through color hierarchy (Black > Red > Grey).
The small scale of the human figures at the bottom anchors the massive typographic elements above.
The repetition of the diagonal angle in the text and the left border stripe creates rhythmic unity.
coreInvariants: Stark white background with no environmental details.
Triadic color scheme of Black, Bright Red, and Neutral Grey.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two figures positioned in the lower-left quadrant, scaled small to emphasize the weight of the typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large black 'T' in the top-left of the text block acts as the primary entry point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the top-left black text, slides down the diagonal red text to the right, and then drops to the figures at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space on the right and bottom right balances the dense typographic cluster.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black (Primary Text) for maximum legibility and weight.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright Red (Secondary Text/Border) for urgency and visual pop.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the white background and dark text; high saturation red against neutral grey.

letterConstructionRules: Tight kerning resulting in touching characters
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'i' dot is a large square block integrated into the top edge.
Letters are sheared or rotated to follow a 15-degree upward diagonal.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme scale contrast between a heavy display face and a light, spaced-out secondary face.
graphicDevices: Diagonal hazard stripes on the left margin

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary vertical weight and compact width.
Offers a similar industrial, urban feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, desaturated photo of two men in casual urban clothing (hoodies, jackets) in a dynamic running or leaning pose against a pure white studio background. Add a vertical strip of diagonal red, black, and grey stripes on the far left edge.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place two lines of ultra-bold uppercase sans-serif text. The top line is black and horizontal. The second line is bright red, tilted 15 degrees upward, and overlaps the first. A third grey layer of text sits behind the red. Add a small line of wide-tracked metadata text parallel to the red line.

verificationChecks: Do the text layers overlap significantly?
Is the red text tilted at an upward angle?
Are the human figures desaturated and high-contrast?

adjustableVariables: Color of the accent text (Red could be Yellow or Blue)
Density of the left-side stripe pattern
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
Any specific logos or branding marks
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is not illegible due to overlap.
Check that the red color is vibrant and not muddy.
Verify the figures appear to be interacting with the same ground plane.
Confirm the diagonal angle is consistent across all tilted elements.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [High-Contrast Urban Photography] at the base with [Overlapping Diagonal Geometric Typography] in a [Black/Red/White] palette to create a [Kinetic 90s-inspired] layout.
